comments: WCAG 2.2 engine for coding agents: 37 tools as an MCP server and CLI (audit, fix, document, watch, gate). Verified against the official W3C ACT rules test cases; findings cite criterion, severity and step-by-step remediation in English and Spanish. Includes behavioral checks (keyboard traps, screen-reader transcript, reflow at 320px) beyond static rules, a write-time gate that refuses saves introducing new high/medium findings, and SHA-256-sealed evidence packs. MIT; zero telemetry. ACT rules consistency is tested on every commit.
features: Accessibility engine for coding agents and developers: audits HTML (static and rendered with a real browser), PDF and DOCX documents against WCAG 2.2 with a 0-100 score. Every finding carries the criterion, severity, plain-language issue and step-by-step remediation, in English or Spanish. Includes keyboard-trap detection, screen-reader transcript, pixel-level contrast sampling, 320px reflow checks, and blindfold usability journeys where an AI agent attempts real tasks non-visually. Ships as an MCP server (37 tools), a CLI, a GitHub Action and a write-time gate that refuses code saves introducing new high/medium findings.
title: a11y-toolkit
